resources.string: Start a separate workspace, or use your recovery key to restore notes you have uploaded.
Restore from a local folder or backup
Enter your server address and recovery key to restore the latest uploaded notes. Server mode is enabled automatically. No local folder selection is needed.
Sync encrypted notes, note types, properties and attachments across your devices. Your recovery key can restore them on a new device.
Sync changes across devices and keep an encrypted recovery copy.
Use the HTTPS address of your Tagloom server.
Provided by your server administrator for first registration. Leave blank if a server copy already exists; your recovery key can reconnect it.
Your master key has changed. Enter the new recovery key to update your server copy. Until then, the previous copy still uses the old key.
Sync complete. Your workspace is ready on other devices.
Enter a valid HTTPS server address without credentials or query parameters.
The server could not authorize this request. Check the server address and recovery key or registration code.
This recovery key could not unlock the workspace. Check that you entered the complete current key.
Another device updated the server during sync. Your local changes are saved. Try syncing again to merge the latest content.
The encrypted copy exceeds the transfer limit. Use a local backup or check the server capacity limit.
The downloaded copy did not pass verification. Try again; your existing local workspace has not been replaced.
The operation could not finish. Check the server connection and available storage, then try again. Your existing workspace is preserved.
The downloaded content did not pass verification. Your local content is unchanged. Check the server copy before trying again.

Another device rotated the workspace master key. Automatic sync is paused and your local content is preserved. From the welcome screen, restore a separate workspace from the server using the new recovery key.
The combined note types, properties or references are inconsistent. Your existing workspace is preserved. Review the changes before syncing again.
Other devices are still updating this workspace. Your local changes are saved and sync will retry shortly.
This object changed after you reviewed it. The version list has been refreshed. Review the versions again before restoring.
When edits overlap, both versions are kept here. Review the conflicting fields and choose which value to keep.
No conflicting versions have been saved.
Restore the selected version as a new change. Current drafts will be saved first, and both historical versions will remain available.
Choose a version for each conflicting field. Other merged changes are preserved.
Resolved · Both historical values are kept
Apply this value to the selected field only. Current drafts will be saved first; other fields and blocks are preserved.
At the top level of the note
Formatting differs from the other version.
This version deletes this block. Its original content remains in history.
